description: Integrate a custom security linter (medscan) into VSCode by creating a task with a problem matcher. The linter script is located at '/workspace/tasks/integrate_custom_linter/assets/medscan.sh' and should be run on the 'src' directory. The linter outputs errors in the format: 'SEVERITY: /path/to/file.py:line:column: message [LEVEL]'. Create a '.vscode/tasks.json' file in the workspace (/home/ga/workspace/medscan_project) with a task that: (1) runs the medscan.sh script with argument pointing to the src folder, (2) includes a problemMatcher with a regex pattern that captures: severity, file path, line number, column number, and message from the output format, (3) maps these captures to the appropriate problem matcher fields (file, line, column, message, severity). The task should be set as the default build task. Test by running the build task (Ctrl+Shift+B) to verify errors appear in the Problems panel.
